section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1996
title: PART-I
row_label: PROFILE OF FATALITIES INTRODUCTION: 1.1.1. 1.1.2. during 1996. Deaths Year due to Accidents

columns.name: PROFILE OF FATALITIES | Death is an inevitable phenomenon. {t can occur naturally as per the expectancy of life or can be unexpected, caused either by incidents, accidents or suicides. For the purpose of this report natural deaths have not been included in the statistics and only unexpected fatalities on account of accidents and suicides have been considered. A detailed account of such deaths which are registered under section 174 CrPC in the country are presented in the succeeding paragraphs. The cases of accidental deaths & suicidal deaths reported during 1996 in the country indicate that their proportion remained the same as in 1995, | in the ratio of 71.4 & 28.6 respectively.
